This is your manual checklist. Ticking a box does not upload, schedule or publish anything on Instagram or Metricool. Existing plans there are kept separate; check them before scheduling again.

Import your content plan

Select your original HTML overview or its calendar JSON export. Preview it first, then save it to your private calendar. Existing posts and their checkmarks will be preserved.

Maximum 50 posts per import, 2 MB per file. Your plan is never added to public website files.

Your reminders

Unscheduled and unpublished posts are highlighted here from the day before their post date. Mark a post as scheduled or published to clear its reminder.

Automatic checks can be delayed; this is not an exact-time alarm. You can turn off a reminder for an individual post below.
